_doc: Single source of truth for reactivation PN automation. One entry per vertical describing how to SOURCE a post (which report, how to rank it, how to read its text) and how to WRITE copy from it (what to delete, what shape the source is). The selector (pn-select.py) is generic; ALL vertical-specific behaviour lives here. Captured against the live board reports 2026-08-19.

_ranking_doc.why_no_absolute_floor: The reports' impression column is `Average of no_of_impressions on All Interactions`, and its SCALE differs per vertical: Shop Tips/Mandi run 500-130k, Scheme runs 500-4,467. A fixed 5,000 floor deletes all 68 Scheme posts while keeping 73 Mandi ones. So reach is gated RELATIVE to each report, never absolutely.
_ranking_doc.reach_floor: Default 'median' = keep only posts at or above the median reach of THEIR OWN report. Self-calibrating: kills the tiny-reach flukes that inflate the ratio without demanding a cross-vertical number. An integer overrides it with an absolute floor if an operator ever wants one.
_ranking_doc.rank_mode: 'primary' ranks by rank_metrics[0] and breaks ties with the rest, in order (Shop Tips/Scheme/Mandi). 'sum' adds all rank_metrics (FMCG, which has no single Formula - it exposes Like% and Comment% separately).

slots._note: assign a vertical; null = operator has not decided this slot yet

_slots_doc: 7 daily reactivation sends (from the 'Reactivation PN - by time slot' sheet). vertical assignment is an operator decision - the mapping above is a sensible default, not verified against the live campaign calendar. Two slots deliberately null pending your call. NOTE: shop_tips appears twice but sustains only ~1 fresh post/day (see supply) - do not assign it two daily slots without a backfill pool.

shop_tips.delete_target: the method/tip itself - the PN promises the outcome and withholds how
shop_tips.copy_register: outcome or threat to the shop; green for opportunity, red for warning
shop_tips.supply: BOTTLENECK - ~18 posts / 14-day window, ~1 usable/day. Cannot feed a daily slot alone.
shop_tips.example: Sawan sales post ba66bc7a; Cadbury gift-box post 6533c30f

scheme.delete_target: the free item / the offer quantity - PN keeps the brand, deletes what you get
scheme.copy_register: brand + free surprise; yellow deal temperament; seasonal peg when present
scheme.supply: 68 posts, high Formula but ALL low-reach (max 4,467 avg). Count is fine; every pick is low-reach by nature - do not apply an absolute floor.
scheme.example: 'KitKat - 10 MRP wala, 1 jaar lene par 2 unit free' -> delete the 2-units-free

mandi.text_source: ugc_posts.post_description; format is 'कमोडिटी का नाम :<X> / जानकारी कहां से मिली :<source>'
mandi.delete_target: the price direction and number - PN keeps the commodity, deletes up/down and how much
mandi.copy_register: price move; direction emoji (down/surprise), never celebratory; CTA is the constant 'तेजी-मंदी रिपोर्ट'
mandi.supply: ABUNDANT - 220 posts, 73 above 5k reach. Can feed multiple slots/day. Perishable: teji_mandi drops after 3 days.
mandi.example: 'कमोडिटी: नारियल / जानकारी: होलसेलर' -> delete the direction+₹

fmcg.text_source: ugc_posts.post_description; format is 'प्रोडक्ट का नाम :<X> / क्या बदलाव है :<रेट|वजन|पैकेजिंग|नया लॉंच>'
fmcg.delete_target: the new rate/weight - PN keeps product + that SOMETHING changed, deletes the value
fmcg.copy_register: value-giving hook, clickbait sanctioned; question titles and hard numbers allowed
fmcg.supply: MODERATE - 32 posts, 12 above 5k reach. NO Formula metric; ranked on Like%+Comment% sum (confirm this is the metric you trust).
fmcg.example: 'प्रोडक्ट: टाटा नमक ₹32 / क्या बदलाव: रेट' -> delete the new rate

_dedupe: Never re-send an item. Checked against pn-select-log.json (the routine's own ledger) AND specs/pn-corpus-duo-image.csv (115 item ids already used by live campaigns).
_open_decisions: Which Formula for scheme/mandi - primary is Formula, tiebreak Formula 2. Confirm Formula (not Formula 2) is the intended rank.
FMCG ranking - defaulted to Like%+Comment% sum since it has no Formula. Confirm.
Slot->vertical map - two slots null; shop_tips assigned twice but can't sustain it.
campaign_key null for scheme/mandi/fmcg - each needs a registry entry (audience + kvPairs) before pn-schedule.py can send it. Only shop_tips (reactivation_exp_image_pn) exists today.
